title: Acupuncture Treatment for Improving Alzheimer's Dementia
brief_summary: Evaluate cognitive improvement pre amd post acupuncture treatment in patients with probable alzheimer's dementia as measured by MOCA score and also per form A( measure of patient's personal information). Also caregiver input.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Mild to moderate AD

Exclusion Criteria:

* Severe AD
